title: Concept Checking Question / Choice Item
description: Schema for interactive choice-based concept checking questions and practice items. Every CCQ must be a choice item with options, correctOptionIndex, and explanation.

question.description: The question text checking concept or target structure.

targetStructure.description: The word, phrase, or target grammar/vocabulary structure being checked.

options.description: 2-3 short option choices matching the .qopt buttons on the page.

correctOptionIndex.description: Zero-based index of the correct answer in the options array.
